notes.title: Violent Witches: the Vindicator, released!
notes.notes:
The game is released on 29th June.

This game is just translated after the Japanese version, so if you have any suggestions about the English expressions, please let us know.
We will gradually update the game.

We also plan to release the Italian, German, Russian versions in the future.
If you are interested in the version, please feel free to contact us.


Saizwong, 29th June
